During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] '''operative''' disappeared in the refugee camps of [[Pencael IV|Pencael Four]]. He was eventually found half-dead from a disease and rescued, returning safely to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Missing SIS Agent}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Update 4.1. that altered the text of many Crew Skill missions to make them faction-neutral changed him from an SIS agent to an unaligned reconnaissance operative.
